statement: Verdant Engine composes music from a Verdant Prism's features as MIDI 1.0 messages, deterministically, refusing invalid features by name, so that a song or a whole soundtrack of the Prism can be generated (REQ-PRISM-GENERATION).

Verdant Engine encodes the audio it synthesizes as Broadcast Wave Format files, bit for bit deterministic, so that every audio artifact of a Verdant Prism has a declared media type (REQ-PRISM-GENERATION).

Verdant Engine encodes the frames it renders as PNG images at their full rendered resolution and colour depth, bit for bit deterministic, so that raster artwork of a Verdant Prism, such as its cover art, has a declared media type (REQ-PRISM-GENERATION).
Verdant Engine renders vector artwork as SVG documents, deterministically, so that vector artwork of a Verdant Prism, such as its logo, has a declared media type (REQ-PRISM-GENERATION).
